what: The flowing pattern across the whole panel is drawn with dots on a 4px grid (staggered 45°), and neighboring dots are stuck together gooey (.58), so the black blobs ripple slowly like halftone newspaper print. On open the pattern is revealed from the black panel over 2s (.3s delay). While pressed, amplitude doubles and flow becomes 1.5x, and on release it returns 3% per frame.

options.goo: How strongly dots stick together, default .58 (0 means separate dots)
options.bias: Brightness bias, default 0 (negative values shrink the black blobs)
options.invert: If 1, dark dots are stamped on top of the background (default 1)
options.reveal · delay · ease: Initial reveal duration · delay · curve, default 2 · .3 · 0.31,0.75,0.22,1
options.[data-fx-part=canvas]: (if present) draws on that canvas — if not, creates one inside the panel

note: Load three first (_vendor/three@*/build). Do not draw when off-screen or in a hidden tab. Text on the panel layered with mix-blend-mode: difference stays readable over the dots, like the original
